mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_reply (post_id, content, prompt_type, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{postId}, #{content}, #{promptType}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, content, prompt_type, is_deleted, create_time FROM ai_reply WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, post_id, content, prompt_type, is_deleted, create_time FROM ai_reply WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_reply SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
